firstPlayerRule: Randomly choose who receives the starting-player moose. That player begins the first action phase, followed by the others clockwise.
clarifications: In later rounds, whoever placed Vikings last in the action phase receives the moose and starts the next action phase.
This opening procedure is for two to four players; solo play has no competing starter.
